name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Strategic Client & Account Management Professional | Retention, Expansion & Executive Advisory
summary: Strategic account and client management professional with 15+ years driving retention, product adoption, and expansion across SaaS, agency, and B2B environments, including direct channel sales into the healthcare vertical. Manages a portfolio of client relationships end to end, from onboarding through renewal, using Salesforce and CRM data to diagnose account health, resolve risk, and identify expansion opportunities. Runs QBRs and executive-facing reporting cadences as the primary point of contact for stakeholder relationships, and brings a genuine personal commitment to healthcare and mental-wellness access.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across the account.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs to client leadership and translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners in Salesforce, spanning health, home-services, and retail verticals (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Sold channel partnerships to agencies focused on healthcare clients, a meaningful share of the partner book, developing direct B2B experience in the healthcare vertical.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, analyzing utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Guided customers through complex technical setup of reputation and marketing-automation tools, equipping them to communicate product value to their own end customers.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Served a banking-industry client end to end and helped pursue a major banking prospect in the northeastern U.S., reaching finalist stage in that deal.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
